name: Giant Wither Statue House
description: A minecraft statue of the Wither, built big in blackstone with three white-eyed heads and a ribbed spine you can enter. A ladder runs up inside the body. Dark blocks make up most of the cost. A landmark piece for a base entrance or boss-themed area.

subBuilds.description: Randomly place blocks at a height of 15 to 20 blocks
Skip one block and place the block like this
Do the same on the other side as well
Repeat the same process on the other side too.
Make the same Wither head on the other side
Break some blocks and place blocks like this
Place any armor on the armor stand
Place the book on the chiseled bookshelf
